step0_head_selection.selection_criterion: lowest val_f_f (force loss on NEB-like geometry sample)

step1_energy_fixed_geom.metric: Per-reaction eMAE (meV) on image-0-anchored relative energy profiles: rel(e)=(e-e[0])*1000, each method anchored to ITS OWN image 0. Macro-averaged over 30 reactions. Source line: eval_benchmark_sp_fw2.py:215,219-221

bias_R2_from_delta_head_md.STATUS: SUPERSEDED - v2 values now computed from eval_benchmark_sp_fw2_full.json
bias_R2_from_delta_head_md.bias_definition: pooled signed mean error over 300 image-0-anchored points
bias_R2_from_delta_head_md.R2_definition: per-reaction 1 - SSR/SST, then averaged over 30 reactions
bias_R2_from_delta_head_md.REVERSAL: delta_head.md Sec.5 says 'R2 slightly worse (0.973 -> 0.967)'. That is v1. For v2, R2 IMPROVES: 0.9734 -> 0.9899.

step1_energy_fixed_geom.anchor: image 0, per-method self-anchored (NOT profile minimum). Cancels constant offsets; image-0 error is identically zero for every method.
step1_energy_fixed_geom.aggregation: macro-average over reactions; equals pooled here because every reaction has exactly 10 images

v1_vs_v2_resolved.RESOLUTION: NOT a file disagreement. delta_head.md Sec.5 reports the v1 head; eval_benchmark_sp_fw2.json reports v2.
v1_vs_v2_resolved.control: bare-MACE columns identical across both files, as expected for an unchanged frozen base model

step2_forces_fixed_geom.metric: Per-reaction fMAE: per image, mean |F_pred - F_ref| over ALL force COMPONENTS (natoms x 3), averaged over 10 images, x1000. Macro-averaged over reactions. Source: eval_benchmark_sp_fw2.py:163-166

cosine_similarity_from_doc.definition: per-atom cosine between predicted and reference force 3-vectors, atoms with |F|<1e-6 skipped; pooled over 3490 atoms
cosine_similarity_from_doc.note: wB97X-D3 cosine (0.3216) ~ MACE cosine (0.3223): MACE faithfully reproduces its training level's force directions; the delta head is what moves them toward wB97M-V.

step2_forces_fixed_geom.component_convention: per Cartesian COMPONENT, not per-atom vector norm. A norm convention would be ~sqrt(3)x larger.

macro_average_used_here.definition: mean of the 30 per-reaction values; each reaction weight 1/30

pooled_in_benchmark_doc.definition: all error components concatenated across reactions, one mean; weights by atom count (eval_benchmark_sp_fw2.py:259-261)

aggregation_note.note: Both correct for their own convention; gap 0.4 meV/A. Not a disagreement.

step2_forces_fixed_geom.delta_force_derivation: analytic autograd through the head (eval_benchmark_sp_fw2.py:146), not finite differences; f_delta is a true conservative gradient

step3a_barriers_vs_wb97m.metric: Forward barrier = max_i (E(i) - E(0)) over the 10-image band; reverse = fwd - (E(9)-E(0)). Source: _collect_uma_m_and_fw2_barriers.py:30-41. Reported bias = mean signed error over 30 reactions; MAE = mean absolute error. Reference: neb_wb97m_fwd_meV
step3a_barriers_vs_wb97m.discretization_caveat: Barrier is the max over 10 DISCRETE images, not an interpolated or optimized saddle; all methods biased low by the same discretization (largely cancels in Step 3a where geometries are shared)

step3b_barriers_vs_ccsdt.metric: Forward barrier = max_i (E(i) - E(0)) over the 10-image band; reverse = fwd - (E(9)-E(0)). Source: _collect_uma_m_and_fw2_barriers.py:30-41. Reference: ccsdt_fwd_meV (CCSD(T)/def2-TZVP single points on the same fixed ORCA geometries)
step3b_barriers_vs_ccsdt.reference_caveat: CCSD(T) is single-reference, so it is least trustworthy on the high-MR tier - exactly where MR character was the selection criterion. NEVPT2/CASSCF exists as the separate gold standard.

neb_fw2_barrier_vs_wb97m.metric: NEB-driven forward barrier (meV); delta_fw2_neb_fwd_meV vs neb_wb97m_fwd_meV

rmsd_vs_orca_all30_from_doc.source: mace_delta_neb_benchmark.md (no local per-reaction JSON for bare MACE NEB on all 30)
rmsd_vs_orca_all30_from_doc.FLAG: Aggregates from benchmark document, not recomputed from JSON

convergence.finding: 6 reactions wrote a converged marker but terminated with fmax 0.064-0.132 eV/A after 447-772 steps (500-step budget; ASE nsteps carries across both NEB phases). Clean runs max 434 steps - no overlap.
convergence.caveat: rxn7949 and rxn7937 are high-MR reactions; their NEB barriers rest on non-converged bands.
convergence.all45_context: 43/45 markers; 35/45 strict; rxn0894 and rxn1147 failed outright (not in the 30)

rmsd_definition.formula: Kabsch RMSD: centroid-align both, optimal rotation via SVD of covariance with diag(1,1,det) enforcing a PROPER rotation (reflections excluded), RMSD = sqrt(mean_a |R*p_a - q_a|^2)
rmsd_definition.which_geometry: transition_state.xyz = highest-energy image of each method's own final band (mace_delta_neb.py:236); a discrete band maximum, not an optimized saddle
rmsd_definition.limitation: atom order assumed to correspond; no permutation matching. Safe here (common T1x ancestry) but invalid for independently generated structures.

step4_neb_driven.neb_protocol: endpoints BFGS to fmax=0.05; 10-image band from T1x wB97X-D3 path; plain NEB to fmax=0.15 (improvedtangent); then climb=True, CI-NEB to fmax=0.05; 500-step cap; ODE optimizer (mace_delta_neb.py:199-234)

mace_bare_neb.source: ~/mace_bare_neb_results/<rxn>/neb.db ; extraction identical to fw2 (max(E(i)-E(0)) over last 10 images)
mace_bare_neb.NOTE: Previously listed as unavailable - the directory is mace_bare_neb_results, not mace_neb_results.

optimisation_cost.CORRECTION: mace_delta_neb_benchmark.md quotes 15.9x more iterations. That is a MEAN OF PER-REACTION RATIOS, inflated by reactions where bare MACE converged in 1-4 steps (rxn1962 gives 221x, rxn9246 86x, rxn4063 62x).
optimisation_cost.recommendation: Quote median 2.18x or total 1.29x, not 15.9x. Directional claim is solid.
optimisation_cost.convergence_note: Both methods 30/30 markers and 24/30 strict; 5 of 6 step-limited reactions are shared. Step-limitation is a property of those reactions, not of the correction.

step5_stratification.tier_definition: FOD (fractional occupation number weighted density) ranking, PBE/def2-SVP at T_el=5000K, N_FOD = sum|n_i - n0_i| (Grimme & Hansen). high=ranks 1-10 (strongest MR), mid=11-20, low=21-30. n=10 each.
step5_stratification.method: Reactions grouped by the 'group' field in full_benchmark_results.json; each metric recomputed within the group using the identical formula. No definition changes between tiers.
step5_stratification.statistical_caveat: n=10 per tier is small; barrier MAEs are outlier-sensitive and no confidence intervals were computed. Tier differences below the spread of individual reaction errors are not resolved.
